title: A HOUSE OF DYNAMITE
description: In this explosive action series, a quiet home becomes the center of chaos as hidden enemies, secret agendas, and dangerous traps collide. Each episode uncovers a new threat, pushing the hero deeper into a deadly maze where every move could ignite disaster. With VJ JUNIOR’s energetic and thrilling narration, Ugandan viewers stay hooked as the tension rises from one episode to the next!
